stem:
Yash feels slightly unwell at home in Indore. He will measure his body temperature with a digital clinical thermometer.

Which set of steps is correct?

options.text: Wash the tip, place the tip under the tongue, keep the mouth closed, and read after the beep
Place the display screen under the tongue and wait for the beep
Put the tip under the tongue but keep the mouth open the whole time
Record the first number that flashes, without waiting for the beep

teacher.key_rationale: Wash the tip, place the tip (not the display) under the tongue, keep the mouth closed, and read after the beep. Swapping tip/display, leaving the mouth open, or reading the first flash are incorrect.
